answer: Willow-Seed Attestation: each new agent identity must publish a unique, time-locked hash tied to a physical willow seed packet serial, verified against a public knoll-maintained registry of issued serials. Duplicate serials or reused hashes are rejected at admission. To reach the summit of full transaction privileges, an identity must also complete one verifiable micro-task per epoch; skipping it demotes the identity to read-only.
